name: Ticket board
description: A kanban board of your tickets in the chat, and the tools and triage skill the agent files and moves them with.

tools.name: ticket_board
tools.description: Show the kanban board (all columns with their tickets). Start here when asked what is on the board, what is blocked, or what to work on next.

project.description: limit the board to one project label

done_limit.description: how many recent Done cards to show (default 10)

tools.name: ticket_create
tools.description: Create one ticket on the board. Use it after triaging raw input into atomic issues. Put the raw input in `source` VERBATIM (never a paraphrase) so the ticket can be re-triaged later, and pass a stable `dedupe_key` so re-running triage over the same input returns the existing ticket instead of creating a duplicate.

title.description: imperative one-liner, e.g. "Fix save race in settings"

body.description: what is wrong, what done looks like, any evidence

project.description: project folder name this belongs to (e.g. waifufy-code)

status.description: one of: inbox, todo, doing, blocked, done

source.description: the verbatim raw input this ticket came from

source_ref.description: where it came from, e.g. "slack #dev 2026-11-05" or a file path

dedupe_key.description: stable key such as "<project>:<short-slug>"; reuse it when re-triaging

tools.name: ticket_list
tools.description: List tickets, open work first (priority then oldest). Call this before creating tickets so you can dedupe against what already exists.

query.description: substring match on title, body or id

tools.name: ticket_get
tools.description: Full detail for one ticket by id (WC-12), including comments and optionally the event log.

tools.name: ticket_move
tools.description: Move a ticket between columns. Moving to "blocked" requires a reason: say what it is waiting on. Use "doing" when you start work and "done" only when it is genuinely finished.

status.description: one of: inbox, todo, doing, blocked, done

comment.description: optional note recorded with the move

tools.name: ticket_update
tools.description: Edit a ticket’s title, body, project, priority or labels. Status is not editable here — use ticket_move.

tools.name: ticket_comment
tools.description: Append a comment to a ticket — progress notes, findings, or a handoff.
